subject: Stagewise activation agenda + eval slate / CANARY & TRAINING cadence
messages:
From: Carmen Silva <carmen@novafin.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@novafin.com>, contracts@novafin.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — embedding implementation timeline into MAP

Thanks Aisha — quick note from my side to set expectations before legal finalizes the contract: we need a MAP that includes a stagewise activation plan (pilot/canary => ramp => full rollout), an evaluation slate for our SRE and product teams, and a training cadence for our ops and support org. Ideally we can get a draft MAP with timelines and owners this week so procurement can sign off concurrently with legal.

High-level constraints:
- Pilot window: 2–3 weeks (limited subset of traffic)
- Evaluation gates: latency, error-rate, cost-per-token targets
- Training: two 90-minute sessions + an on-call handover doc

Appreciate if you can call out required evidence (SOC2 excerpts / audit logs) and a clear rollback plan in the doc. Attaching our internal onboarding checklist for reference (we'll share more after legal).

— Carmen
Director, Platform Engineering
NovaFin

Attachment: novafin_onboard_checklist.pdf (attachment stub)

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Carmen Silva <carmen@novafin.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@novafin.com>, contracts@novafin.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — embedding implementation timeline into MAP

Hi Carmen — thanks for the clarity. We're aligned on the structure. I put together an initial stagewise activation agenda and a first-pass evaluation slate; uploading as novafin_map_v1.xlsx and canary-checklist-v2.pdf (attached). Highlights:

- Pilot / Canary (Week 0–2): 1% traffic to Redwood-optimized model variant; ops playbook, KV prefix caching enabled. Owner: Marissa.
- Acceptance gates (end of week 2): P95 latency < 220ms, error rate < 0.3%, qualitative sample pass rate >= 92% on the eval set.
- Ramp (Week 3–4): 10% ⇒ 50% traffic progression with automated rollback if gate breaches. Owner: Vivek.
- Full rollout (Week 5): 100% with monitoring retention increased and runbook handoff. Owner: Jordan.

Training plan
- Session 1 (Week -1): Ops + SRE deep dive (90 mins) — runbook walkthrough, alert tuning.
- Session 2 (Week 1): Support & product — prompt governance and evaluation reporting.
- Handover doc: oncall_handover.md (we'll publish to the Drive link).

Open items for procurement/legal concurrently:
1) Data residency confirmation for NovaFin workloads (we propose Dedicated in us-west-2).
2) SLA exception window for pilot (we recommend 99.5% during pilot).
3) Evidence: SOC2 Type II excerpts + 30-day audit log snapshot (we can provide link).

Can you confirm owners + any constraints on pilot traffic or required blackout windows? If you sign off, we'll convert this into a MAP section and send an updated XLS with explicit JIRA action items.

Thanks — Aisha
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: novafin_map_v1.xlsx, canary-checklist-v2.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — embedding implementation timeline into MAP

Looping in operational details. Quick notes on the canary checklist I edited:
- Add an automated KV-cache warmup step (pre-pilot, +24h) to reduce cold-start token variance.
- Canary telemetry: include per-route cost delta and prefix hit rate.
- Recovery drill: plan a synthetic rollback test on day 3 of pilot (simulate failure and measure MTTR).

I'll prepare the MOP (method of procedure) and a short script for the KV warmup. Also recommend a single Slack channel (novafin-redwood) for real-time ops during pilot — Jordan, can you provision the temporary channel and invite NovaFin SREs?

— Marissa
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: canary-runbook-draft.md

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@novafin.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Carmen Silva <carmen@novafin.com>, contracts@novafin.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — embedding implementation timeline into MAP

Thanks team — this looks good. A couple of clarifications from procurement/legal:
- Data residency: must be us-west-2 only for PII scopes (acknowledged).
- SOC2 excerpts can be redacted, but we need written confirmation of log retention for 90 days.
- Can the pilot SLA be a temporary exception? Procurement prefers a written note in the MAP that pilot operates under an exception from the default SLA.

On the pilot window: NovaFin prefers a Monday start and a Friday end so our weekly operations review aligns. Can you adjust the draft to show a 14-calendar-day pilot starting Monday 26 Apr? Also please include a short paragraph describing rollback criteria in plain English for our Exec review.

Thanks — Alex
Sr. Manager, Procurement | NovaFin

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Carmen Silva <carmen@novafin.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@novafin.com>, contracts@novafin.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Stagewise activation agenda + eval slate (draft for legal & procurement)

Hi Carmen / Alex / team — attaching the updated MAP section and canary checklist per your notes. Changes included:
- Pilot dates: Mon 2027-04-26 → Fri 2027-05-09 (14 calendar days)
- Pilot SLA: noted exception clause and explicit acceptance checkbox for procurement.
- Data residency: confirmed us-west-2 for PII scopes; retention: 90 days for audit logs.
- Rollback criteria (plain language): immediate rollback if any of the following occur for two consecutive evaluation checkpoints: P95 latency degraded > 30% vs baseline, error-rate spikes > 0.5% absolute, or production-quality samples fail the manual eval threshold twice.

Next steps:
1) Contracts: if you confirm procurement language, contracts@novafin.com can route for signature and we will mark the MAP as post-signature implementation plan.
2) Ops: Marissa will publish the final canary runbook to the shared Drive by Monday and provision the Slack channel.
3) Training: Sessions scheduled (calendar invites sent) — please accept.

Attachments: novafin_map_v1.xlsx (updated), canary-checklist-v2.pdf (updated)

If that aligns, I'll mark the thread as agreed and push JIRA tasks for each owner.

Best — Aisha
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0148
